title: feat: add list drag-to-reorder, command palette, dark mode toggle, and Chinese docs
body:
Summary

This PR adds four improvements to the Nexus Editor:

1. List Item Drag-to-Reorder (packages/core/src/live-preview.ts)

- Users can reorder Markdown list items by dragging grip handles (⠿)
- Custom mousedown/mousemove/mouseup drag (no HTML5 Drag API)
- Editing lock prevents CM6 from rebuilding widget DOM mid-drag
- Uses `replaceRange` for single-transaction undo

2. Command Palette (apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/command-palette.ts)

- Spotlight-style overlay (Ctrl+K or ⌘K toolbar button)
- Fuzzy search across 14 registered commands
- Keyboard navigation (↑↓ Enter Escape) and mouse click support

3. Dark Mode Toggle (apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/app.ts)

- 🌙/☀️ button in toolbar for one-click theme switching
- Settings persisted to localStorage

4. Chinese Documentation (packages/plugin-slash/README.md)

-   Usage examples in Chinese: basic setup, custom commands, filtering/ranking

5. Files Changed

- packages/core/src/live-preview.ts — list drag-to-reorder
- packages/plugin-slash/README.md — Chinese docs
- apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/command-palette.ts — new command palette component
- apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/app.ts— UI integration
- apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/style.css— new UI styles

+
+## 中文使用示例
+
+### 基础用法
+
+在编辑器中使用 Slash 命令菜单：
+
+```typescript
+import { createEditor } from "@floatboat/nexus-core";
+import { createSlashPlugin, createSlashMenuUI } from "@floatboat/nexus-plugin-slash";
+
+const editor = createEditor({
+  container: document.getElementById("editor")!,
+  plugins: [
+    createSlashPlugin([
+      {
+        id: "h1",
+        title: "标题 1",
+        keywords: ["h1", "标题"],
+        description: "一级标题",
+        run: (e) => {
+          e.replaceSelection("# ");
+          return true;
+        },
+      },
+      {
+        id: "bold",
+        title: "加粗",
+        keywords: ["bold", "粗体"],
+        description: "加粗文本",
+        run: (e) => {
+          e.replaceSelection("**文本**");
+          return true;
+        },
+      },
+      {
+        id: "todo",
+        title: "待办事项",
+        keywords: ["task", "任务", "checkbox"],
+        description: "插入复选框",
+        run: (e) => {
+          e.replaceSelection("- [ ] ");
+          return true;
+        },
+      },
+    ]),
+  ],
+});
+
+// 挂载浮动菜单
+const menu = createSlashMenuUI(editor);
+```
+
+### 自定义命令
+
+你可以根据自己的需求添加自定义命令：
+
+```typescript
+import { createEditor } from "@floatboat/nexus-core";
+import { createSlashPlugin, createSlashMenuUI } from "@floatboat/nexus-plugin-slash";
+
+const editor = createEditor({
+  container: document.getElementById("editor")!,
+  plugins: [
+    createSlashPlugin([
+      {
+        id: "insert-date",
+        title: "插入日期",
+        keywords: ["date", "日期", "today"],
+        description: "插入当前日期",
+        run: (e) => {
+          const date = new Date().toLocaleDateString("zh-CN");
+          e.replaceSelection(date);
+          return true;
+        },
+      },
+      {
+        id: "insert-time",
+        title: "插入时间",
+        keywords: ["time", "时间", "now"],
+        description: "插入当前时间",
+        run: (e) => {
+          const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString("zh-CN");
+          e.replaceSelection(time);
+          return true;
+        },
+      },
+    ]),
+  ],
+});
+
+const menu = createSlashMenuUI(editor);
+```
+
+### 过滤与排序
+
+`filterSlashCommands(commands, query)` 按确定性规则排序：
+
+1. 标题精确匹配
+2. 标题前缀匹配（短标题优先）
+3. 关键词精确匹配
+4. 标题子串匹配（偏移量靠前优先）
+5. 关键词前缀匹配
+6. 关键词子串匹配
+
+平局时按标题字母序排列。空查询保留原始注册顺序，可通过插件顺序自定义"最常用优先"。
+
+更多 API 详情请参考 [API 文档](./src/types.ts)。
